featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Dalal
featured_reviews.review_text:
First things first, the staff both at the building and at the coworking space were polite and lovely. However, that is the only positive thing I have to say. This may be the worst coworking space I have ever been to, and I'm genuinely shocked that they even market it as a coworking space.

What it is is a glorified cafe - if you get a day pass and try to work here, they shove you into a random table in the corner of their lunch room (picture attached), with uncomfortable and unergonomic chairs. My shoulder started hurting within a few minutes of sitting here.

Since it is their lunch room, it's also not quiet - so not suitable for working, and definitely not suitable for taking calls or meetings. There is no room for taking calls.

There is coffee and water, but you have to take it in a tiny paper cup (photo attached). I don't think they even had crockery or cutlery to eat lunch with.

To make matters worse, the address they send of the location on Google Maps is wrong (wrong side of the street), and getting to the space is an absolute maze and none of this is explained beforehand. You have to hand full a register on the ground floor, take a lift up one floor, walk out and past a Starbucks, then go through another gate, where you will find lifts of which only one of them actually goes to the 25th floor. It took me 20 minutes to go from the entrance of the building to the entrance of the space.

The bathroom is fine, and I guess there's a view if you're into that - but it was a hazy day.

I left in an hour and went home, which for myself and most people will be significantly quieter, more productive and more comfortable. I can't believe I paid money to work here and was in half a mind to ask for a refund.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been working from this co-working space for the past week and my experience has been truly wonderful, thanks to the incredible support of the Karuna (Centre Manager) here.

She is extremely kind, humble, and always goes the extra mile to help everyone. From resolving small issues instantly to making sure members feel comfortable and welcomed, her dedication really stands out. It’s rare to come across someone who is so genuinely helpful and positive.

AWFIS co-working space is lucky to have her — she truly elevates the entire experience. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: Enam Sambhav WeWork in Mumbai offers a well-designed, modern co-working environment that caters to professionals seeking flexibility and community. The space is thoughtfully laid out with ergonomic furniture, high-speed internet, and ample natural light, creating a productive atmosphere. Meeting rooms and common areas are easily accessible and equipped with necessary amenities, supporting both focused work and collaborative sessions. The location is convenient, with good connectivity to public transport and nearby dining options. Overall, Enam Sambhav WeWork provides a professional, vibrant workspace ideal for startups, freelancers, and established businesses looking for a dynamic office solution. Voila, bon appétit for your review!

featured_reviews.name: Robbin Payapilly
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place to plan workshops. I enjoyed delivering a workshop there.

The systems are so good and organised.

featured_reviews.name: Malhar Lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
WeWork Bandra is one of the best coworking spaces in Mumbai, offering a perfect blend of productivity and vibrant energy. The atmosphere is dynamic yet relaxed, making it an ideal place for professionals, startups, and freelancers.

The crowd here is fantastic—young, energetic, and diverse, creating a collaborative and inspiring work environment. The space itself is well-designed, with modern interiors, comfortable seating, and plenty of natural light. Whether you're working solo or in a team, there are ample options, from private cabins to open desks and lounge areas.

The community vibe is strong, with regular networking events, workshops, and social gatherings that make working here more than just about business. Plus, the amenities—great coffee, high-speed WiFi, and helpful staff—add to the overall experience.

If you're looking for a coworking space in Bandra with good vibes, a great crowd, and a motivating atmosphere, WeWork Bandra is a top choice.

featured_reviews.name: Pritam Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place for an interview. Its has great place to host meetings and organise activities. This place has 2 common floor for food and other stuff. Its like a cafe for the building employees. Next is the parking. It has great parking space as well as underground parking. On the ground floor you would find Starbucks.

featured_reviews.name: Eva
featured_reviews.review_text: Well maintained wework. Staff is very friendly and will help you out with everything. During lunch hours you'll have to wait a bit to get tables as most will be taken. The conference in the ground floor is simply beautiful! Great coffee at the coffee counter as well!

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Saugat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been going there for more than 3-4 years.
Good office space, but poor experience with the membership pausing/termination process and the overall response from the community team felt quite unempathetic
Received conflicting information about contract terms and policies from different team members. Whole process felt unnecessarily rigid and unclear.
For a brand like WeWork, especially in such a prime location, I expected a much smoother and more professional experience.

featured_reviews.name: Daniel Sin
featured_reviews.review_text: Great co-working space. Quite easy to locate and traffic is not too heavy during peak hour.

featured_reviews.name: bhavesh rakhasia
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best office infra in the city. Unique stylist interior designs. Each chair, light, table are nicely selected and placed on every floor. Free high-speed WiFi for WeWork employees. Nice conference rooms with state of the art equipments for video conferencing or presentation. Entire floor reserved for food & beverages. WeWork BKC serves free beers almost everyday post 6pm.
